strings.zh: 什么？我这边听不清,{NEWLINE}难道电话坏了？{SCROLL}请你从别的地方{NEWLINE}再打一个过来试试！
strings.en: What? I can’t hear you very well.{NEWLINE}Maybe we’ve got a bad connection?{SCROLL}Try calling again from somewhere else.

strings.zh: 你好,最近你怎样？{NEWLINE}我身体很好哦！{SCROLL}
这世上的强者有很多,{NEWLINE}你想要变强就得不断地跟他们战斗！
strings.en: There are plenty of strong folks in this{NEWLINE}world. If you want to get stronger,{CLEAR}you gotta keep battling them!

strings.zh: 我一般在星期五的早上{NEWLINE}有空闲时间！{CLEAR}到时你可以打电话给我！
strings.en: My free time?{NEWLINE}I’m usually available Friday mornings.{CLEAR}Try calling me again then!

strings.zh: 嗨,你好！{SCROLL}和我再来对战一场怎么样！{CLEAR}可以吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hey, you!{SCROLL}Battle me again!{NEWLINE}What do you say? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哦,太棒了！！{SCROLL}我太高兴了！{NEWLINE}我在战斗前线的训练家屋{CLEAR}等你！
strings.en: Oh, fantastic!!{SCROLL}That makes me so happy! I’ll be{NEWLINE}waiting for you at the Trainer{CLEAR}House at the Battle Frontier!
strings.notes: US 0652/6 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.en: I see...{NEWLINE}You must be pretty busy.

strings.zh: 嗯⋯⋯{NEWLINE}虽然我是无所谓,{CLEAR}可是,{CLEAR}你还有其他的预约{CLEAR}没有完成啊。
strings.en: Hmm...{NEWLINE}Well, I appreciate that you want to{CLEAR}battle me again, but didn’t you promise{CLEAR}someone else?

strings.zh: 我们约好了在战斗前线{NEWLINE}的训练家屋对战的！{CLEAR}你别忘了！
strings.en: We agreed to battle at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle{CLEAR}Frontier! Don’t you forget!
strings.notes: US 0652/9 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 嗨！我是马志士！{NEWLINE}你还好吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Yo! This is Lt. Surge.{NEWLINE}How are you?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我们不是约好了在战斗前线的{NEWLINE}训练家屋对战吗,{CLEAR}难道你已经忘了？{SCROLL}我先告诉你一下,{NEWLINE}我一直都等着你的！
strings.en: Didn’t we agree to battle at{NEWLINE}the Trainer House at the Battle{CLEAR}Frontier? Don’t tell me you forgot!{SCROLL}Just so you know, I’ve been{NEWLINE}waiting for you this whole time!
strings.notes: US 0652/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 你认为我是为什么{CLEAR}在枯叶市道馆里设下机关呢？{SCROLL}没错！{NEWLINE}就是为了调查前来挑战的{CLEAR}训练家的头脑！{SCROLL}精灵的对决,{NEWLINE}并不单单比拼力量和耐力！{SCROLL}关键还是在力量和智慧上,{CLEAR}兼顾这些的人,{CLEAR}才能成为优秀的训练家！
strings.en: So, why do you think I put all those{NEWLINE}traps in the Vermilion Gym?{SCROLL}That’s right!{NEWLINE}It’s to test the intellect of any{CLEAR}Trainer who comes in to battle!{SCROLL}Pokémon battles aren’t just about{NEWLINE}power or stamina.{SCROLL}If you can balance power and{NEWLINE}intelligence, then you’ve got the{CLEAR}makings to become a great Trainer!

strings.zh: 我在精灵联盟军队的时候,{NEWLINE}是所有训练家中{CLEAR}最为出类拔萃的。{SCROLL}可是！{SCROLL}自从遇见了你,{NEWLINE}我看到了更出人意料的对战技巧！{SCROLL}你是在哪里进行训练的？{NEWLINE}是从谁那里学习战斗技巧的？{SCROLL}真是不可思议！
strings.en: Back in the Pokémon League army,{NEWLINE}I was the best of all the Trainers.{SCROLL}But!{SCROLL}Ever since I met you, I’ve seen{NEWLINE}battle skills that blew me away!{SCROLL}Where did you train? Who{NEWLINE}taught you how to battle?{SCROLL}It’s unbelievable!

strings.zh: 我在枯叶市{NEWLINE}当道馆馆主期间,{CLEAR}学习了这个国家的语言。{SCROLL}但是我还有好多话听不懂。{SCROLL}嗨！你以后能和我多说话吗？{SCROLL}我们来相互学习{NEWLINE}对方的语言吧！
strings.en: I’ve been learning this country’s{NEWLINE}language during my time as Vermilion Gym{CLEAR}Leader. But there’s still a lot I don’t{CLEAR}understand. Hey! Will you talk with me{CLEAR}more from now on? Let’s teach each{CLEAR}other our languages!
strings.notes: US 0652/14 | RV071: meaning: country's language / each other's languages, not regional dialect (D-1995)
